name: Sakura Noa
source:
Rintarou's girlfriend.
A bright girl who can not refuse a request if pushed. She has a sexy body but her mind is like that of a maiden. Recently she has been getting lessons from Rintaro to improve her grades.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc065/character_2.html]official website[/url]]
